summary.text: Jason Bellamy-Fults is the Democratic candidate for Florida State Senate District 6 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Jennifer Bradley (R) and Joseph Thornton of the American Solidarity Party of Florida.
An educator who works in academic technology at the University of Florida, he is a former union electrical worker.

paragraphs.text: Jason Bellamy-Fults graduated from Lakeland High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Berea College in 2006, and earned a graduate degree from the University of Florida in 2023.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a fourth-generation Floridian who spent a few years in Asia after college and returned to Florida in 2008.

He said he has worked with the Community Weatherization Coalition and was a union electrical worker with IBEW Local 1205 before moving into adult education at Santa Fe College and the IBEW apprenticeship program.

Bellamy-Fults said his campaign priorities include addressing the cost of living, including housing costs, utility bills and insurance, and securing living wages and a voice in the workplace for working people.
He advanced from the canceled August 18, 2026 Democratic primary without appearing on the ballot.
